item.title: OPINION: Style labels taint individuality – The Appalachian
item.description: Since rising to popularity in 2019, TikTok has seen plenty of growth in its user base. The platform was originally considered a music app, but its For You feed system now caters to many different forms of entertainment. Much of TikTok’s content revolves around self-expression, from outfits you want to show off to the latest album you heard.

item.title: App State developing new campus master plan – The Appalachian
item.description: App State has begun the process of developing a new master plan, which will guide the university’s development over the next several years, Chancellor Heather Norris announced Jan. 9 in a weekly message. This will replace the previous Master Plan 2025, which was created in 2017 under former Chancellor Sheri Everts.
